description: This file is a TypeScript script for generating bundled channel configuration metadata, involving importing modules, defining types, and exporting functions to collect and write metadata based on plugin sources and schemas.

methods.name: resolveChannelConfigSchemaModulePath
methods.description: Resolves the path to the channel config schema module within a plugin directory.

methods.name: resolvePackageChannelMeta
methods.description: Extracts channel metadata from a plugin's package.json.

methods.name: resolveRootLabel
methods.description: Determines the label for a channel, prioritizing package metadata, then manifest name.

methods.name: resolveRootDescription
methods.description: Determines the description for a channel, prioritizing package metadata, then manifest description.

methods.name: formatTypeScriptModule
methods.description: Formats source code into a TypeScript module string with proper headers.

methods.name: collectBundledChannelConfigMetadata
methods.description: Collects metadata for all bundled channels from plugin sources.

methods.name: writeBundledChannelConfigMetadataModule
methods.description: Generates and writes the bundled channel config metadata module file.
